description: This file defines the class OA_DB_UpgradeAuditor, which manages database upgrade auditing, including logging, querying, and updating audit records related to database schema changes and backups in the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_DB_UpgradeAuditor
classes.description: A class extending OA_BaseUpgradeAuditor that handles database upgrade auditing, including logging actions, querying audit records, and managing backup table information.

methods.name: setKeyParams
methods.description: Sets the upgrade_action_id parameter in the provided array and calls the parent method.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message using the oLogger if available.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message using the oLogger if available.

methods.name: isPearError
methods.description: Checks if the provided message indicates a PEAR error via the logger.

methods.name: queryAuditAll
methods.description: Retrieves all audit records from the log table.

methods.name: queryAuditByUpgradeId
methods.description: Retrieves audit records matching a specific upgrade action ID.

methods.name: queryAuditBackupTablesByUpgradeId
methods.description: Retrieves backup table audit records for a specific upgrade ID.

methods.name: queryAuditAddedTablesByUpgradeId
methods.description: Retrieves records of tables added during an upgrade for a specific ID.

methods.name: queryAuditUpgradeStartedByUpgradeId
methods.description: Retrieves the record indicating the start of an upgrade for a specific ID.

methods.name: queryAuditByDBUpgradeId
methods.description: Retrieves audit record for a specific database action ID.

methods.name: queryAudit
methods.description: Performs a flexible query on audit records filtered by version, timing, schema, and action.

methods.name: queryAuditForABackup
methods.description: Retrieves audit records for a specific backup table name.

methods.name: queryAuditForBackupsBySchema
methods.description: Retrieves backup records filtered by schema and version.

methods.name: updateAuditBackupDroppedByName
methods.description: Updates the audit record for a backup table to mark it as dropped by name.

methods.name: updateAuditBackupDroppedById
methods.description: Updates the audit record for a backup table to mark it as dropped by ID.

methods.name: _listBackups
methods.description: Lists current backup tables, their status, and related audit info.

methods.name: getTableStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specified table.
